Signals: GPS L1 C/A, L2C, L5. Galileo E1, E5, E6. Fixed spoofed position: 69.27547832, 15.96832496, 35 m hae. Power will be ramped up from -35 dBm to 25 dBm in 5 dB steps, with each step lasting 3 minutes. Time offset is + 15 minutes (900 seconds), so "into the future".

Signals: GPS L1 C/A, L2C, L5. Galileo E1, E5, E6. Fixed spoofed position: 69.27547832, 15.96832496, 35 m hae. Power will be ramped up from -35 dBm to 25 dBm in 5 dB steps, with each step lasting 3 minutes. Time offset is - 3 minutes (180 seconds), so "back into the past".

Signals: GPS L1 C/A, L2C, L5. Galileo E1, E5, E6. Fixed spoofed position: 69.27547832, 15.96832496, 35 m hae. 5 minutes of initial jamming (L1, G1, B1I, L2, E5b, L5 with 2 W) prior to spoofing transmission, then continuous on other bands than the ones spoofed. The pseudorange error is applied to all satellites, starting five minutes after the spoofing starts (these first five minutes are "true". The applied error should equal a drift of 3 ns/s.
Signals: GPS L1 C/A. Fixed spoofed position: 69.27547832, 15.96832496, 35 m hae. UNIX time rollover test. Starting time is 03:04:00 19.01.2038 UTC. Incoherent.
Lunch

Signals: GPS L1 C/A, L2C, L5. Galileo E1, E5, E6. 5 minutes of initial jamming (L1, G1, B1I, L2, E5b, L5 with 2 W) prior to spoofing transmission, then continuous on other bands than the ones spoofed. Fixed spoofed position: 69.27547832, 15.96832496, 35 m hae. The UTC-paramter nav. data manipulation consists of the spoofing signal saying that back in 2016, there was 19 leap seconds instead of 18.

Signals: GPS L1 C/A, L2C, L5. Galileo E1, E5, E6. No jamming. Fixed spoofed position: 69.27547832, 15.96832496, 35 m hae. The pseudorange error is applied to all satellites, starting five minutes after the spoofing starts. The applied error is gradually increased throughout the test.
Signals: GPS L1 C/A. Fixed spoofed position: 69.27547832, 15.96832496, 35 m hae. UNIX time rollover, starting time 03:04:00 19.01.2038. Coherent.

Signals: GPS L1 C/A. Fixed spoofed position: 69.27547832, 15.96832496, 35 m hae. The UTC-paramter nav. data manipulation consists of the spoofing signal saying that back in 2016, there was counter-factual extra amount of -127 leap seconds, which in total means that there is removed -145 leap seconds.

Signals: GPS L1 C/A, L2C, L5. Fixed spoofed position: 69.27547832, 15.96832496, 35 m hae. The UTC-paramter nav. data manipulation consists of the spoofing signal saying that back in 2016, there was counter-factual extra amount of -127 leap seconds, which in total means that there is removed -145 leap seconds.

The route will run from Stave to the turning point at the Crossroads and then back to Stave. There will be no stop at the turning point, allowing the motorcade to remain in continuous movement throughout the test while the power level is increasing. The motorcade will drive at a speed of 35km/h. The estimated driving time between Stave – Crossroads is 17 minutes when driving at a speed of 35km/h. The test signal will be on air for 40-minutes without any stop. There will be no initial jamming during this test. The starting and end point is Stave
